newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia stocks slide, Hansapank disappoints.
newsitem.headline: Estonia stocks slide, Hansapank disappoints.

text.p: Estonian stock market prices dipped on Thursday as market leader Hansapank announced a 1997 profit forecast that was seen as below market expectations, dealers said.
Official list trade came to 55 million kroons but the index slipped by 1.56 percent to 190.98.
Hansapank was the most active share but it closed 5.80 kroons lower at 178 kroons.

The bank said earlier it expected a 320 million kroon group profit in 1997, which disappointed some investors. Dealers earlier said they had been expecting a profit forecast of around 370 million kroons.
"It was the first piece of bad news for a long time. With Hansapank being the market leader also other prices could also fall further," one dealer said.
The second largest bank, Savings Bank, had trade of 13.2 million kroons but also closed lower at 84.80 kroons versus 87.80.
Elsewhere on the bank market, Forekspank was stable on turnover of 4.4 million kroons and Tallinna Pank slipped to 66.80 from 67.45 and registered activity of 3.4 million kroons.

The over-the-counter market was led by plastics maker Norma, which had some 14 million kroons of volume and closed higher at 54.95 kroons versus 54 kroons. The total volume of the free market was 25.1 million kroons.
